name: Legged robot (quadruped)
description: Walking robot whose locomotion controller drives one actuator per joint (e.g. ANYmal D: 4 legs x 3 joints).

CHK-CONTROLLER-LOGS.question: Retrieve the locomotion controller and robot state-machine log (mode changes, protective stops, controller switches) for this mission
CHK-CONTROLLER-LOGS.why: A controller switch, protective stop or e-stop at the onset is recorded only by the robot's own software log.
tools: Robot software log (e.g. ANYmal state machine / ROS bag of controller topics)

CHK-NETWORK-LOGS.question: Export the operator link logs (Wi-Fi or mesh signal, joystick message rate) for the mission

CHK-ONSITE-ACTUATOR.question: Inspect the joint drive named in the evidence: drive error register, temperature, encoder and cabling, then the leg it moves
CHK-ONSITE-ACTUATOR.why: A joint that stops following its commands is first a drive question (drive fault, encoder, temperature derating), then a mechanical one (leg, foot, obstruction).

CHK-CLOCK-OFFSET.question: Establish the clock offset between the operator console and the robot's onboard computers
CHK-CLOCK-OFFSET.why: Without a bounded offset between the operator console and the robot's clocks, delays between a command sent and the robot's motion cannot be measured.

CHK-CONFIRM-CONTEXT.question: Confirm the robot model, onboard software release and locomotion controller version for this mission

CHK-REPRODUCE.question: Replay the recorded commands on the same robot on a test stand or in simulation, on the same terrain type

routine_events.why: all 12 joint drives switched between freeze (1) and position control (13) together: the robot standing up or lying down (ANYdrive command modes)
all 12 joint drives changed status word together with that command-mode switch
